seo.title: Work With Me
seo.description: Psychotherapy and counselling for individuals and couples with Dr Lauretta Ogbum — individual and couples therapy, premarital counselling, the Annual Review, the Intensive and Diaspora Sessions.

hero.title: You do not have to figure it all out alone.
paragraphs: Whether you are navigating a difficult relationship, struggling with your emotions or trying to make sense of a major life change, you do not have to work through it alone.
I offer psychotherapy and counselling for individuals and couples, with a compassionate, practical and honest approach.
Not sure where to begin? A brief introductory call gives us an opportunity to discuss what brings you here and explore whether my services are right for you.

services.title: Choose where to start.
services.intro: Every person and relationship is different. Explore the services below to find the support that best fits your circumstances.

fees.title: Side by side.
fees.intro: I believe you should understand the cost and format of a service before committing to it.
fees.tableCaption: Comparison of services, their format and fee
fees.currencyNote: Fees are displayed in the currency selected on the website. Please confirm the applicable currency and final fee before booking.
notes: A limited number of reduced-fee places may be available. If cost is a significant barrier, you are welcome to mention this during your introductory call.

process.title: Four steps, with room to decide.
process.intro: Beginning therapy does not mean committing to an indefinite process. You can ask questions, review your progress and decide whether to continue.

closing.title: You do not need to have all the answers.
paragraphs: Choosing a therapist is a personal decision. An introductory call gives us an opportunity to discuss what brings you here, answer your initial questions and determine whether my approach and services are a suitable fit.
If we decide to proceed, we can arrange the appropriate paid session.
If another form of support would better meet your needs, I will be honest with you.
